english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something wilful, capricious, or difficult to control.
Use this when the person insists on doing what they want, especially in a childish or teenage way.

examples.english: That child is very wayward and refuses to eat whenever he dislikes the food.
The child is very headstrong and cries in the shop if we do not buy it for him.
examples.traditional: 個細路好任性，唔買畀佢就喺舖頭度喊。
